name: Dayet Hachlaf
hero_subtitle: Quieter mountain lake near Ifrane for a peaceful stop away from the busiest shores.

overview.title: A quieter alternative to the main lake circuit
overview.p1: Dayet Hachlaf offers a more low-key lake stop in the Ifrane area. Expect fewer facilities and a stronger sense of open Middle Atlas landscape. Ideal if you already saw Dayet Aoua and want another shoreline without repeating the same scene.
overview.p2: Access is by road from Ifrane; conditions depend on weather. Pack everything you need.
